notes: Written by game design. Daily/weekly coin values are the World 1 base; see GAME_DESIGN.md section 13 for per-world scaling, pool filtering and ordering rules. Story quests are listed in the order they should be offered (the board shows the first 5 open ones).

quests.name: Daily Deposit
quests.desc: Pass 1 lesson today.
quests.lesson: Small, regular deposits of learning compound like small, regular deposits of money.

quests.name: Double Deposit
quests.desc: Pass 2 lessons today.
quests.lesson: Paying yourself extra on a good day speeds everything up.

quests.name: Nailed It
quests.desc: Score 100% on a lesson quiz today. Retakes count.
quests.lesson: Getting it right beats getting it done. Mastery is the goal, not a checkmark.

quests.name: Review Run
quests.desc: Replay a lesson you first finished at least 3 days ago.
quests.lesson: Spaced review is how facts move from 'I read that once' to 'I know that'.

quests.name: Charge It Up
quests.desc: Answer 5 questions correctly in boss fights today. Losing fights count too.
quests.lesson: Retrieval practice under a little pressure: the knowledge is what powers the weapon.

quests.name: Sparring Session
quests.desc: Win any boss fight today. Old bosses count.
quests.lesson: Revisiting old material keeps it sharp while you learn new things.

quests.name: Dear Diary
quests.desc: Write a journal note on one simulated trade: why you took it, where your stop is, and what happened. Win or lose, the note is what counts.
quests.lesson: A trade without a written reason can't teach you anything later.

quests.name: Do the Homework
quests.desc: Submit one stock research analysis.
quests.lesson: Research before you buy, not after it drops.

quests.name: Five-Day Learner
quests.desc: Pass a lesson on 5 different days this week.
quests.lesson: Consistency beats cramming, in learning and in investing.

quests.name: Eight Is Great
quests.desc: Pass 8 lessons this week.
quests.lesson: Steady progress adds up: about one lesson a day finishes a world in a month.

quests.name: Gold Star Week
quests.desc: Score 100% on 4 lesson quizzes this week. Retakes count.
quests.lesson: Fix the gaps now; they cost more later.

quests.name: Spaced Out
quests.desc: Replay 3 lessons you first finished at least 3 days ago.
quests.lesson: Spacing your reviews out is the best-tested study trick there is.

quests.name: Battle Scholar
quests.desc: Answer 30 questions correctly in boss fights this week.
quests.lesson: Lots of low-stakes recall now means no panic on the exam later.

quests.name: Process Over Profit
quests.desc: Journal 3 simulated trades this week. Losing trades with good notes count the same as winners.
quests.lesson: You control your process, not the outcome. Grade the process.

quests.name: Research Week
quests.desc: Submit 2 stock research analyses this week.
quests.lesson: Knowing what you own, and why, is what lets you hold through a scary week.

quests.name: Penny's Leak
quests.desc: Penny has a hole in her savings and it's shaped like inflation. Pass 'Inflation: The Slow Leak'.
quests.lesson: Cash sitting still loses buying power every year.

quests.name: Official Business
quests.desc: Verify your email so you can always get back into your account. Banks verify you for the same reason.
quests.lesson: Account recovery is part of keeping your money (and progress) safe.

quests.name: Plug the Leak
quests.desc: Beat Inflato the Slow Leak.
quests.lesson: You can't out-swing inflation; you out-learn it by putting money to work.

quests.name: The Card Trap
quests.desc: Hoot wants you to see the minimum-payment trap before a card company shows it to you. Pass 'Debt, Credit and the Cost of Borrowing'.
quests.lesson: Paying only the minimum on a card can take years and cost far more than the purchase.

quests.name: First Paycheck
quests.desc: Your first paycheck is smaller than you expected. Find out where it went: pass 'Paychecks and Taxes 101'.
quests.lesson: Gross pay isn't take-home pay: withholding and FICA come out first.

quests.name: Airbag Check
quests.desc: Penny has a rule: no adventure without an airbag. Pass 'Emergency Funds: Your Financial Airbag'.
quests.lesson: An emergency fund turns a surprise bill into an inconvenience instead of debt.

quests.name: Three Months Strong
quests.desc: Build your cushion of knowledge: pass 14 Money Moves lessons, enough to cover How Money Works and Banking & Your Cash. Penny hands over her best armor.
quests.lesson: Three to six months of needs in safe savings is the foundation everything else sits on.

quests.name: Two of a Kind
quests.desc: Wear 2 pieces from the same armor set to switch on its 2-piece bonus.
quests.lesson: Pieces that work together are worth more than their parts.

quests.name: Time in the Market
quests.desc: Pass 'Dollar-Cost Averaging and Staying Put'.
quests.lesson: Investing a fixed amount on a schedule beats waiting for the perfect moment.

quests.name: Autopilot Engaged
quests.desc: Investing works best on autopilot, and so does learning. Reach a 6-day streak: six paydays in a row, no skipping.
quests.lesson: Automatic, regular contributions are how compounding actually gets fed.

quests.name: Many Baskets
quests.desc: Wear armor from 3 different sets at once. The Correlation Charm loves this.
quests.lesson: Diversifying across things that don't move together smooths the ride.

quests.name: The Referee's Whistle
quests.desc: Learn the rules new traders trip over: pass 'The Referees: SEC, FINRA, SIPC, and the Rules'.
quests.lesson: Insider tips, wash sales and the pattern-day-trader rule exist whether you know them or not.

quests.name: Red Flags
quests.desc: Grizz is running a scam-spotting class. Pass 'Grizz's Guide to Passive Income Scams'.
quests.lesson: Guaranteed high returns, urgency and recruiting bonuses are the classic red flags.

quests.name: Grizz's Gauntlet
quests.desc: Grizz has heard every pitch in the book. Beat Count Ponzi and he'll give you the ring he uses to sniff out scams.
quests.lesson: A scheme that needs new money to pay old investors always collapses.

quests.name: Money Moves Graduate
quests.desc: Pass the Money Moves final exam.
quests.lesson: The basics of money are the basics of everything that comes after.

quests.name: Cash Is a Fact
quests.desc: Profit is an opinion. Learn to follow the cash: pass 'Cash Flow: Where the Money Really Went'.
quests.lesson: Profitable companies can still run out of cash. The cash flow statement shows it.

quests.name: Research Intern
quests.desc: Chip needs a research intern. Submit your first stock research analysis.
quests.lesson: Owning a stock means owning a business. Look at the business first.

quests.name: The Research Tower
quests.desc: Submit 5 stock research analyses in total.
quests.lesson: Comparing several companies teaches you what 'good' and 'expensive' really look like.

quests.name: Ignore Mr. Market
quests.desc: Beat Mr. Market. Only trade with him when his price is right.
quests.lesson: You never have to accept the market's price. Wait until it suits you.

quests.name: Paper Trail
quests.desc: Journal your first simulated trade: why you entered, your stop, your size.
quests.lesson: Writing the plan before the trade keeps emotion out of it.

quests.name: Ten Journaled Trades
quests.desc: Journal 10 simulated trades in total: entry reason, stop, size and what happened. Losers count exactly the same as winners.
quests.lesson: A journal turns wins and losses into lessons instead of just feelings.

quests.name: The 2% Rule
quests.desc: Learn why pros think about losses first: pass 'Risk First: The Math of Staying Alive'.
quests.lesson: Risking 1-2% per trade means a losing streak hurts but never ends you.

quests.name: Full Set
quests.desc: Wear all 4 pieces of one armor set to unlock its signature effect.
quests.lesson: Some benefits only show up when you commit to a whole strategy, not half of one.

quests.name: Gold Star Collector
quests.desc: Score 100% on 25 lesson quizzes in total.
quests.lesson: Going back to close every gap is what turns knowledge into skill.

quests.name: Stock Smarts Graduate
quests.desc: Pass the Stock Smarts final exam.
quests.lesson: You can now read a business, value it and size a position. That's rare.

quests.name: After the Earnings
quests.desc: Find out why a call can lose money even when the stock goes up: pass 'Implied Volatility & IV Crush'.
quests.lesson: When implied volatility collapses after news, option prices fall with it.

quests.name: Beat the Clock
quests.desc: Defeat the Theta Reaper before his hourglass runs out.
quests.lesson: Time decay works against option buyers every single day.

quests.name: Rent Out Your Shares
quests.desc: Pass 'Covered Calls: Renting Out Your Shares'.
quests.lesson: Selling a covered call trades some upside for steady premium income.

quests.name: The Wheel
quests.desc: Complete the cycle: you've rented out your shares, now learn to get paid while waiting to buy them. Pass 'Cash-Secured Puts & the Wheel'.
quests.lesson: Cash-secured put, assignment, covered call, called away: premium income with the stock risk fully visible.

quests.name: Buy Insurance
quests.desc: Pass 'Protective Puts & Collars'.
quests.lesson: A put is insurance: you pay a premium for a floor, and the coverage expires.

quests.name: Grizz's Danger Zone
quests.desc: Grizz walks you through every way options go wrong. Pass 'The Danger Zone'.
quests.lesson: Naked selling and oversized bets can lose far more than you expect.

quests.name: Spaced Repetition Pro
quests.desc: Replay 10 lessons in total that you first finished at least 3 days earlier.
quests.lesson: The Greeks stick when you revisit them, not when you binge them.

quests.name: Cap the Volcano
quests.desc: Defeat Magmus Vega in the heart of Volatility Volcano.
quests.lesson: Defined risk lets you survive volatility you can't predict.

quests.name: Options Arena Graduate
quests.desc: Pass the Options Arena final exam.
quests.lesson: Options are tools with sharp edges, and now you know where the edges are.

quests.name: A Deposit, Not a Loan
quests.desc: Pass 'Margin Is a Deposit, Not a Loan'.
quests.lesson: Futures margin is a good-faith deposit, and it can be called at any time.

quests.name: Right-Size It
quests.desc: Bolt's rule: size so you can be wrong ten times and still play. Pass 'Micros, Position Sizing & Staying in the Game'.
quests.lesson: Micro contracts let you size each trade to risk 1% or less, which keeps you in the game.

quests.name: Answer the Call
quests.desc: Defeat the Margin Caller.
quests.lesson: A buffer above maintenance margin is what stops a bad day becoming a liquidation.

quests.name: Hedge Farmer Jo
quests.desc: Farmer Jo needs to lock in a corn price before harvest. Learn how: pass 'Hedging in Real Life'.
quests.lesson: Hedging gives up some upside to protect against the outcome you can't afford.

quests.name: Read the Fine Print
quests.desc: Before anyone sells you a 'funded account', pass 'Prop Firm Evaluations: Read the Fine Print'.
quests.lesson: Most evaluation fees are the business model. Read the rules before paying anyone.

quests.name: Not a Scratch
quests.desc: Win any boss fight without taking a single hit. Old bosses count.
quests.lesson: The best risk management is the loss you never take.

quests.name: Survive the Swan
quests.desc: Defeat the Black Swan.
quests.lesson: You can't predict the rare disaster, but you can be sized and hedged for it.

quests.name: Futures Frontier Graduate
quests.desc: Pass the Futures Frontier final exam.
quests.lesson: Leverage, margin and hedging, understood before you ever touch them for real.
